landing.tagline: Interactive patient cases for clinical education
landing.aboutSubtitle: Open patient case platform for teaching clinical reasoning
landing.aboutPhronesisDef1: Practical wisdom, discernment, and context-dependent clinical reasoning. The central intellectual virtue in Aristotelian philosophy and medicine: the ability to make sound judgments for an individual patient amid real-world complexity (distinct from pure theoretical knowledge epistēmē).
landing.aboutPhronesisDef2: Phronesist: One who exercises and cultivates practical wisdom and clinical judgment.
landing.aboutTeacherHeading: Built for the demands of clinical education
landing.aboutTeacherD1: Presentations are flexibly built from text, image, and question slides to match your teaching scenario. High-resolution images (such as X-rays, ECGs, and lab results) can be clicked to enlarge. Navigate slides using a presentation clicker or arrow keys.
landing.aboutTeacherD2: Poll the audience with multiple choice or brief open-ended questions. Results collect in the background and appear on the main screen only when you reveal them. Each slide can include discussion notes or model answers to support the debrief.
landing.aboutTeacherT3: Files stay on your own device
landing.aboutTeacherD3: No user accounts to manage. Cases are saved as standard .phron files directly on your computer, making them easy to edit in the built-in editor or share with colleagues.
landing.aboutStudentD1: Students join in seconds on their smartphones by entering a four-digit code or scanning the on-screen QR code. Works in any modern web browser without app stores or sign-ups.
landing.aboutStudentD2: Responses are never linked to names, emails, or device identifiers. Complete anonymity removes the fear of making mistakes, encouraging students to answer even when uncertain.
landing.aboutStudentD3: Questions and choices update on students' phones automatically as you advance slides on the projector.
landing.aboutAuthorD1: Phronesist was created by Pauno Komulainen, a specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology based in Kuopio, Finland. It grew out of a practical need in clinical teaching: standard polling tools are built for rapid trivia, whereas medical education requires room for patient narratives, imaging, and measured clinical reasoning.
landing.aboutAuthorT2: Free to use in all education
landing.aboutAuthorD2: Phronesist is completely free to use across all education. No subscription fees, no advertisements, and no hidden commitments.
landing.aboutAuthorD3: All source code is fully open. Anyone is free to audit the implementation, contribute to its development, or host Phronesist on their own institutional server.
